run_chat_completion_client: run the OpenAI chat completion client against a vLLM API server with streaming support
parse_cli_arguments: parse command-line arguments including the --stream flag for streaming responses
create_openai_client: create an OpenAI client configured to use a vLLM API server as the backend
list_available_models: list available models from the vLLM API server and select the first one
send_chat_completion_request: send a chat completion request with messages and optional streaming to the vLLM server
